Spoon the blueberry mixture over the biscuits; sprinkle with the remaining ½ cup oats.
Drizzle the remaining melted butter over the top; the source gives no separate drizzle amount.
Bake 25 minutes until cake is golden brown.

notes: Biscuit can size is not specified; the ½ cup melted butter is shared between dipping and drizzling without an exact split.

title: No-Knead Bread
overview: Plan about 12 hours ahead, then allow about 1 hour for the shaped loaf to rise. Bake at 450°F in a covered Dutch oven: 30 minutes covered, then 15 minutes uncovered.

ingredients.text: 400 g flour (about 3¼ cups), plus extra for dusting

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Stir together 400 g flour (about 3¼ cups), ¼ tsp yeast, and 1 heaping tsp salt in a large bowl.
Add 320 ml lukewarm water.
Use a fork to combine the ingredients. We want to have pretty much all the dry flour incorporated into the wet dough, but you don’t need to stir it past that point.
Cover and let it sit for about 12 hours. (Anything from 8 to 15 hours is probably fine.)
Wet your hands and scoop out the dough. Fold it a few times and shape it into a ball.
Drop it onto some parchment paper and sprinkle some flour on top.
Cover it with a cloth and let it rise for an hour or so.
Put the covered oven-safe pot in the oven and preheat to 450°F.
Open the oven and take off the lid of the pot. Grab the sides of the parchment paper and lift the dough. Lower it into the pot, close the lid, and close the oven.
Bake for 30 minutes. Then remove the lid.
Bake for another 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it cool completely before eating.

notes: If you like warm bread (who doesn’t?), warm it up later, but definitely let it cool first unless you prefer doughy, gummy bread.)
Dip it in olive oil with some salt and pepper and a little balsamic.
Make a bunch of batches at once and fill plastic bags of just the dry ingredients.
Rather than clean the bowl after you scoop out the dough, leave some extra dough in there and leave it in the fridge to use for tomorrow’s loaf and get some sour dough flavor.

title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
overview: Use a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. Refrigerate assembled casserole 8 hours or overnight. Bake covered at 350°F for 45–60 minutes, then uncovered at 325°F for 30 minutes or until set.

ingredients.text: 6 slices white bread, toasted and cubed

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Crumble 1 lb ground pork sausage into a medium skillet. Cook over medium heat until evenly browned; drain.

Whisk 1 tsp mustard powder, ½ tsp salt, 4 beaten eggs, and 2 cups milk. Stir in the cooked sausage, 6 slices toasted and cubed white bread, and 8 oz shredded mild cheddar. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch dish. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cover, and bake 45 to 60 minutes. Uncover, and reduce temperature to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Bake for an additional 30 minutes, or until set.

notes: Submitted by M.K. Meredith. This is the four-egg/milk version; the existing Christmas Breakfast Casserole uses a different egg and dairy ratio.
The index entries Breakfast Sausage Casserole and Jimmy Dean Breakfast Casserole contain the same recipe.

prepGroups.a: Mustard powder, salt, eggs, and milk

title: Aunt Dot’s Chicken Divan
overview: Oven: 350°F. Use a 9×13-inch casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 1 hour 15 minutes.

ingredients.text: 2 heads fresh broccoli, florets only, or 3 boxes frozen broccoli spears

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Arrange florets from 2 heads broccoli (or 3 boxes frozen broccoli spears) in a 9×13-inch casserole. Lay 3 lb thin-pounded chicken cutlets on top. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Mix 3 cans cream of celery soup, 6 tbsp mayonnaise, and 3 tbsp lemon juice. Spread over the chicken. Sprinkle with 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar, then 1 cup plain bread crumbs.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour 15 minutes.

notes: From the recipe photo credited to Donna McKeever. The original image remains in the linked Doc.
The printed recipe specifies cream of celery soup. An unclear handwritten mark beside mayonnaise has not been interpreted. Can and frozen-box sizes are not specified.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Butternut Squash
overview: Trim and halve or quarter Brussels sprouts. Peel squash and cut into 1-inch cubes. Roast at 425°F for 20–25 minutes until caramelized.

ingredients.text: 1 LB. Fresh Brussel Sprouts, Trimmed, & Halved or Quartered
1 LB Fresh Butternut Squash, Skinned, Cut & Cubed (1")

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Trim and halve or quarter 1 lb Brussels sprouts. Peel and cut 1 lb butternut squash into 1-inch cubes.
Spread the prepared vegetables on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with 3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil.
Add ½ cup raw pecans.
Add 2 sprigs fresh thyme and salt and pepper to taste.
Mix
Roast at 425°F for 20–25 minutes.
Let everything roast until caramelized! YUM

prepGroups.a: Vegetables, oil, thyme, pecans, salt, and pepper

title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Biscuits
overview: Serves 4. Brown chicken in a skillet; slow cook 4 hours on High or 6 hours on Low. Keep the ½ cup dredging flour separate from the 3 tbsp added to the slow cooker.

ingredients.text: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, chopped into bite-size pieces
4 boneless, skinless chicken thighs, chopped into bite-size pieces
1 small butternut squash, peeled and chopped into bite-size pieces (about 2 cups)
6 sprigs thyme, leaves removed and chopped

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Dredge the bite-size pieces from 4 chicken breasts and 4 chicken thighs in ½ cup flour; season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken on all sides.

Put the browned chicken, 1 small peeled and chopped butternut squash (about 2 cups), 3 chopped celery ribs, 3 peeled and chopped carrots, 1 chopped large onion, 6 sliced sage leaves, leaves from 6 thyme sprigs (chopped), and the remaining 3 tbsp flour in the slow cooker. Season with salt and pepper, mix, and pour in 3 cups chicken stock. Cover and cook undisturbed 4 hours on High or 6 hours on Low.
Just before serving, stir in 1 cup thawed peas and 2 tbsp Dijon mustard. From the 2 tbsp each chopped dill and parsley, reserve a little for serving and stir in the rest. Heat through.
Place 1 biscuit in each of 4 bowls. Spoon the chicken mixture over the biscuits and top with the reserved dill and parsley.

notes: The saved file also has an isolated Instant Pot note (5 minutes high pressure, 5 minutes natural release). It lacks a complete adapted method, so the slow cooker method is used here.

prepGroups.a: Squash, celery, carrots, onion, sage, and thyme
prepGroups.b: Peas and Dijon; keep dill and parsley separate to reserve garnish

title: Chicken and Broccoli Penne
overview: Cut chicken into ¾-inch pieces, prepare broccoli florets, and freshly grate cheeses. Combine the dry seasonings before cooking. Cook pasta and broccoli together while sauce simmers.

ingredients.text: 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into ¾-inch pieces
1 cup dry white wine see notes
0.5 cup Asiago can also use all parmesan., freshly grated

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Combine 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp mustard powder, and 2 pinches red pepper flakes (optional). Set aside.

Season 2 large chicken breasts, cut into ¾-inch pieces, with lemon pepper seasoning (amount unspecified). Heat 4 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 2–3 minutes per side until browned; remove and set aside.
Bring a large pot of salted pasta water to a boil while you begin to prepare the sauce as outlined below.
Add 1 cup dry white wine to the chicken skillet over medium heat. Scrape up the browned bits and reduce by half, about 4 minutes.
Add 6 tbsp butter and 6 cloves garlic (prep unspecified); cook 1 minute. Stir in 4 tbsp flour and cook 1–2 minutes, stirring continuously.
Gradually stir in 1½ cups chicken broth, then 2½ cups half-and-half. Add 2 tsp hot sauce and the reserved seasoning mixture. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and partially cover.
Boil 1 lb penne to al dente according to its package. Add 8 cups broccoli florets during the last 4 minutes; drain.
Reduce sauce heat to low and slowly stir in 1½ cups freshly grated Parmesan and ½ cup freshly grated Asiago (or additional Parmesan).
Remove from heat and stir in 4 tsp lemon juice. Add the cooked pasta, broccoli, and chicken; stir to combine. Taste and season with salt if desired.

overview: Rise 8–12 hours at room temperature, then cold ferment 2–4 days (3 days preferred). Rest 2–3 hours at room temperature before stretching.

Cover the bowl tightly with a lid plastic wrap and allow to rise at room temperature for 8 to 12 hours.

Dust some flour on top and cover with a towel to rest at room temperature for 2-3 hours before stretching and baking.

Freeze the balls if you want to use them later instead of the cold ferment (Step 3). If freezing, put the balls separated on a tray and put them in the freezer for an hour or so. Once frozen you can put them in individual zip lock bags and toss them back in the freezer. When you want to use some, take some out of the freezer and put the refrigerator the night before and proceed to step 4 when ready to use.

title: Foolproof Pan Pizza
overview: Makes two 10-inch pies, serving 4–6. Rest dough 8–24 hours, then 2 hours in oiled pans. Bake at 550°F for 12–15 minutes.

ingredients.text: 400 grams (14 ounces, about 2 1/2 cups) bread flour
10 grams (.35 ounces, about 2 teaspoons) kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling
4 grams (.15 ounces, about 1/2 teaspoon) instant yeast
275 grams (9.5 ounces, about 1 cup plus 3 tablespoons) water
8 grams (.25 ounces, about 2 teaspoons) extra-virgin olive oil, plus more to coat pans and drizzle
1 1/2 cups pizza sauce, such as our New York-style pizza sauce
12 ounces grated full-fat, dry mozzarella cheese (see note above)
Small handful torn fresh basil leaves (optional)
2 ounces grated parmesan or pecorino Romano cheese (optional)

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Mix 400 g bread flour, 10 g kosher salt, 4 g instant yeast, 275 g water, and 8 g olive oil in a bowl large enough to hold 4–6 times the dough volume. Mix until no dry flour remains.
Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap, making sure that edges are well-sealed, then let rest on the countertop for at least 8 hours and up to 24. Dough should rise dramatically and fill bowl.

Sprinkle the top of the dough lightly with flour, then transfer it to a well-floured work surface. Divide dough into two pieces and form each into a ball by holding it with well-floured hands and tucking the dough underneath itself, rotating it until it forms a tight ball.

Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil in the bottom of two 10-inch cast iron skillet or round cake pans. (See note above). Place 1 ball of dough in each pan and turn to coat evenly with oil. Using a flat palm, press the dough around the pan, flattening it slightly and spreading oil around the entire bottom and edges of the pan. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let the dough sit at room temperature for two hours. After the first hour, adjust an oven rack to the middle position and preheat oven to 550°F.

After two hours, dough should be mostly filling in the pan up to the edges. Use your fingertips to press it around until it fills in every corner, popping any large bubbles that appear. Lift up one edge of the dough to let any air bubbles underneath escape and repeat, moving around the dough until there are no air bubbles left underneath and the dough is evenly spread around the pan.

Top each of the 2 dough rounds with ¾ cup pizza sauce and 6 oz shredded mozzarella (1½ cups sauce and 12 oz cheese total), reaching the edges. Season with salt to taste; add desired toppings, an olive oil drizzle, and optional torn basil.

Bake 12–15 minutes until golden and bubbly on top and crisp underneath. Sprinkle the optional 2 oz grated Parmesan or Pecorino Romano across the two pizzas. If the bases need more crisping, cook each pan over medium stovetop heat 1–3 minutes, moving it for even browning. Transfer to a board, cut each into 6 slices, and serve.

steps: The day before, mix ¾ cup dark brown sugar, ¾ cup white sugar, ½ cup paprika, ¼ cup garlic powder, 2 tbsp each black pepper, ground ginger, and onion powder, and 2 tsp rosemary powder. Salt each rack with ½ tsp kosher salt per side, then season with rub; the rack quantity and amount of rub used are unspecified.
Wrap half racks in foil. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, up to two days ahead of grilling.

Combine 1 cup applesauce, 2 cups ketchup, ¼ cup each cider vinegar, butter, maple syrup, and A-1 sauce, ½ tsp liquid smoke, 1 diced medium onion, 1 tbsp garlic (form unspecified), 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp seasoned salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and 1 tsp Tabasco. Blend with an immersion blender to chop the onion and simmer until thickened; duration is unspecified.
Grill ribs for 20 minutes, adding barbecue sauce and turning every 5 minutes.

notes: Despite a “Sous Vide” heading in the file, the saved cooking instructions use oven and grill. This differs from the existing Sous Vide Ribs recipe.
Rib quantity, total rub usage, garlic form in sauce, and sauce simmering duration are not specified.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
overview: Grease and flour a large tube pan. Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours; test with a cake tester.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Cream 1 cup butter with 3 cups sugar. Add ¼ tsp baking soda, 1 cup sour cream, and 1 tsp vanilla.
Add 6 jumbo eggs and 3 cups sifted flour in 3 additions: 2 eggs and 1 cup flour each time.
Beat well after each addition.
Grease and flour a large tube pan.
Bake at 325 degrees for 1½ hrs.
Test for doneness with a cake tester

notes: Buttercream option in source: beat ½ cup butter and ½ cup vegetable shortening until smooth; add 1 box confectioners’ sugar, ¼ cup milk, and 1–2 tsp vanilla. Box size not specified. The author doubles the frosting for this cake.

prepGroups.b: Sour cream, baking soda, and vanilla

title: Roquefort Sauce for Steak
overview: Before cooking, prepare the chopped, sliced, grated, or otherwise prepped ingredients as listed below. Keep ingredients separate unless they share a labeled prep bowl.

ingredients.text: 3 cups dry white wine or white vermouth
Freshly cracked black pepper, to taste

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Cream 1 lb softened Roquefort (2 cups) and 1 cup softened unsalted butter until smooth.
Boil 3 cups dry white wine or vermouth with 4–6 tsp freeze-dried green peppercorns until reduced to about 2 tbsp. Add 2 cups heavy cream and boil until reduced by half.
Reduce heat to moderately low. Gradually whisk in the prepared cheese–butter mixture, then 6 tsp finely minced parsley. Remove from heat and keep warm.
Season with freshly cracked pepper. Do not add salt; Roquefort is salty. Serve over or alongside grilled steaks.

notes: The saved recipe lists rosemary sprigs without specifying their use. Steak quantities and cooking directions are not provided; this entry is the sauce.

title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
overview: Before cooking, prepare the chopped, sliced, grated, or otherwise prepped ingredients as listed below. Keep ingredients separate unless they share a labeled prep bowl.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Cover 1 lb radiatori with 4 cups cold water and add 2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil; boil about another 6 minutes until al dente.
Add 1 can evaporated milk (size unspecified), 2 tbsp butter, the separate 1 tsp sauce salt, and 2 cups grated cheddar.

notes: Evaporated-milk can size is not specified. The source lists optional chicken tenders, hot sauce, and Gorgonzola but provides no chicken cooking instructions.

prepGroups.a: Evaporated milk, butter, sauce salt, and cheddar

title: Stuffed Peppers (Sundays at Moosewood)
overview: Fill 6 large peppers and bake covered at 350°F for 30–45 minutes until soft.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Prepare 2 cakes tofu or 2 lb beef. The source gives no initial preparation method or tofu cake size; confirm before cooking.

Sauté 1 cup chopped onion, 1 large garlic clove (prep unspecified), ¼ tsp cinnamon, and ¼ tsp ground red pepper in 3 tbsp vegetable oil until the onion softens. The listed 1 tsp cumin has no addition step.
Add 2 chopped large tomatoes, 1 chopped small apple, and ⅓ cup raisins.
simmer 5 min
Add the prepared beef or tofu, ⅓ cup chopped almonds, and 1 tbsp vinegar. Season with salt to taste.
simmer 10 minutes
Fill 6 large peppers with the prepared filling.
Pour 1 cup tomato juice into the baking dish.
cover with foil
bake at 350 for 30 – 45 minutes until soft

stages.title: Sauce
steps: Purée ½ cup sour cream, ½ cup toasted walnuts, ⅓ cup cream cheese, ¼ cup milk, 1 tsp cinnamon, and ¼–½ tsp red pepper in a blender.

notes: Tofu cake size, initial meat/tofu preparation, garlic prep, and the point at which cumin is added are unspecified. “Puree sauce ingredients in blender” applies only to the Sauce subsection.

prepGroups.a: Onion, garlic, cinnamon, and ground red pepper

title: Sushi Rice
overview: Before cooking, prepare the chopped, sliced, grated, or otherwise prepped ingredients as listed below. Keep ingredients separate unless they share a labeled prep bowl.

ingredients.text: 3⅓ cups sushi rice, rinsed and drained

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Put 3⅓ cups rinsed and drained sushi rice and 4 cups water in a covered pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil 2 minutes, then boil 5 minutes at medium heat and cook 15 minutes on low, as stated in the source.
Heat 5 tbsp plus 1 tsp rice vinegar with 5 tbsp sugar and 4 tsp salt until the sugar dissolves.
Remove rice from heat. Spread a clean towel over the pot and let stand 10–15 minutes.
Spread rice evenly in a casserole dish. Fan rice while separating grains with a spatula and gradually adding vinegar mixture. Continue until room temperature, about 10 minutes.
Keep covered with a clean towel until ready to use.

notes: The saved note says “4 cups in rice maker,” while its detailed method is stovetop; the detailed stovetop quantities and method are preserved.

title: Swiss Cheese and Mushroom Quiche
overview: Makes one 9-inch pie, 4–6 servings. From The Moosewood Cookbook by Mollie Katzen. Mushroom cutting style is not specified.

ingredients.text: Salt, pepper, and a dash of thyme for sautéing

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Cover the bottom of one 9-inch pie crust with 1½ cups grated Swiss cheese. Sauté 1 chopped medium onion and ¼ lb mushrooms in butter (amount and mushroom prep unspecified), with salt, pepper, and a dash of thyme. Spread over the cheese.
Beat 4 eggs, 1½ cups milk, 3 tbsp flour, ¼ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp dry mustard. Pour over the mushroom layer and sprinkle with paprika to taste.
Bake at 375°F for 40–45 minutes, until solid in the center when jiggled.

notes: Variations
Substitute cheddar cheese for Swiss
Use fresh tomato slices instead of mushrooms. (Tomatoes don’t need to be sautéed first)
Substitute 1 cup chopped scallions for the onion.
Add 1 tsp. prepared horseradish.
Dr. McCarty’s Changes
Use Pillsbury refrigerated pie crust.
Use any kinds of cheese, but best if you use at least two types of cheese.
It is very important to sauté whatever vegetables you use before putting them on top of the cheese layer.
Butter quantity and mushroom cutting style are not specified in the saved source.

title: Swiss Cheese and Onion Soup
overview: Mince garlic, thinly slice onions, warm milk, and grate Swiss. Divide butter: 2 tbsp for onions and 3 tbsp for the roux.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon dry sherry (or more, to taste)

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan. Add 1 minced garlic clove, 3 cups thinly sliced onions, ¾ tsp dry mustard, and 1½ tsp salt. Sauté until tender.
Add 2 cups water or stock. Cover and simmer over low heat.
In a separate saucepan, melt remaining 3 Tbs. butter. Whisk in 3 Tbs. flour and cook, whisking over low heat, one minute.
Whisk in 1½ cups warmed milk. Cook on low, whisking, until thick and uniform, 5–8 minutes.
Add ½ tsp prepared horseradish, 1 tbsp dry sherry (or more to taste), and 1½ cups grated Swiss.
Stir the cheese sauce into the onions. Add black pepper to taste, ½ tsp tamari, 3 drops Tabasco, and optional Worcestershire (amount unspecified). Cook on low 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Salt and pepper to taste, then serve with some fresh grated cheese on top.

title: Beef Tacos
overview: Heat taco shells in a 200°F oven while the beef filling simmers 10 minutes.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon minced fresh serrano chile OR jalapeño

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Preheat oven to 200°F degrees.
Brown 2 lb ground round in 1 tsp canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat; drain excess fat.

Stir in 3 tbsp minced white onion, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp salt, ⅛ tsp black pepper, ½ tsp cumin, 1 tbsp chili powder, ½ tsp oregano, 1 tsp minced serrano or jalapeño, and 1½ cups tomato sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10 minutes. Meanwhile warm 24 taco shells in the 200°F oven.
Fill hot taco shells with meat mixture, and top with shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes and grated cheese.

prepGroups.a: Onion, garlic, seasoning, chile, and tomato sauce

title: Tequila Watermelon
overview: Use two 9×13-inch baking dishes. Cut watermelon into 1-inch wedges; refrigerate in syrup at least 45 minutes.

ingredients.text: 1 small seedless watermelon, quartered and cut into 1 inch thick wedges

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Arrange 1 small seedless watermelon, cut into 1-inch wedges, in two 9×13-inch dishes. Bring 1 cup sugar, ¾ cup water, ½ cup tequila, and ¼ cup triple sec to a boil; cook until sugar dissolves. Cool slightly, pour over the watermelon, and refrigerate at least 45 minutes.
Lift watermelon out of the syrup and arrange on a platter. Squeeze the 2 limes, cut into wedges, over it and season with flaked sea salt to taste.

prepGroups.a: Sugar, water, tequila, and triple sec

title: Thai Basil Chicken
overview: Mince garlic, slice onion thinly, cube chicken, tear basil, and chop tomatoes.

ingredients.text: 1 onion, cut in half and sliced into thin strips
2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 1 1/2 pound), cut into bite-size pieces
1 bunch fresh basil (about 1/2 cup), torn into pieces

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Heat 1 tbsp canola oil over medium heat. Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp red pepper flakes for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Add 1 onion, halved and thinly sliced; cook about 5 minutes until translucent. Add 2 chicken breasts (about 1½ lb), cut into bite-size pieces; cook 3–5 minutes until browned and cooked through.

Mix ¼ cup oyster sauce, ¼ cup hoisin, 2 tbsp soy sauce, and 1 tbsp sugar; stir into chicken. Reduce to medium-low. Scatter 2 chopped large tomatoes and 1 torn bunch basil (about ½ cup) on top. Leave unstirred about 5 minutes to warm the tomatoes and wilt the basil, then stir until combined and hot.
Serve immediately over rice.

notes: A separate from-memory fish-sauce variation remains in the original file. The complete oyster/hoisin sauce version is used here.

prepGroups.b: Oyster sauce, hoisin, soy sauce, and sugar

title: Tomato Pie
overview: Makes one 13×18-inch pizza, serving 4–6. Bake at 450°F for about 20 minutes (source notes “less!”), then cool at least 15 minutes.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (17.5 ounces, about 3 1/2 cups) all-purpose flour
6 grams (.175 ounces, about 1.5 teaspoon) rapid-rise yeast
30 grams (1 ounce, about 2 1/4 tablespoons) extra-virgin olive oil, plus ¼ c for greasing pan
325 grams (11.5 ounces, about 1 cup plus 6 tablespoons) water
4 cloves garlic, grated on a microplane grater
1 (28-ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, roughly pureed in a food processor or blender
1/2 ounce finely grated Pecorino Romano cheese

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Process 500 g flour, 10 g salt, 6 g rapid-rise yeast, 325 g water, and the source method’s 0.35 oz olive oil (about 10 g) until dough rides around the blade, then process 30 seconds more. Confirm the oil discrepancy before cooking: the ingredient list instead specifies 30 g.

Pour remaining 1/4 cup olive oil into a 13- by 18-inch rimmed baking sheet and spread over entire inner surface with your hands. Transfer dough to baking sheet and turn in oil until thoroughly coated. Spread gently with your hands. (It will not stretch to fill the pan; this is fine.) Cover baking sheet with plastic wrap and allow to rise at room temperature until dough has slackened and started to spread out toward the edges of the pan, 2 to 3 hours. Carefully remove plastic wrap from pizza dough. Using oiled hands, and working as gently as possible to maintain air bubbles, push and stretch dough into the corners of the pan by pressing out from the center, lifting each corner, and stretching it beyond the edge of the pan. It should pull back until pan is just filled with dough. Set aside for 20 to 30 minutes while you make the sauce.

For sauce, heat 2 tbsp olive oil and 2 tbsp butter. Add 4 grated garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano, and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes; cook about 1 minute. Add one 28 oz can puréed whole tomatoes, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 whole shallots or small onions (as listed). Simmer about 45 minutes until thick. Salt to taste and cool in the fridge.

Two hours before baking, remove dough from fridge. Generously grease the inside of a 13- by 18-inch rimmed baking sheet with olive oil (about 3 tablespoons). Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Form into flat ball and transfer to baking sheet. Using your hands, coat the ball on all sides with olive oil. Loosely cover the baking sheet with plastic and let dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour. The dough should spread out . (Try rolling out with rolling pin instead)

Carefully stretch and push the dough into the corners and edges of the pan. Cover loosely, and let rise for 1 hour longer. Meanwhile, adjust oven rack to upper middle position and preheat oven to 450°F. When dough has risen, gently dock center with finger tips and use your hands to create a risen ridge about 1-inch wide around the edge.

Spread all the prepared sauce over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border. Bake about 20 minutes at 450°F (the saved note suggests less), rotating halfway, until edges are golden and crisp. Cool at least 15 minutes. Sprinkle with ½ oz grated Pecorino Romano, cut, and serve.

notes: Source discrepancy: dough ingredient list says 30 g olive oil, but its first direction says 0.35 oz (about 10 g). It also moves dough from a fridge without specifying an earlier refrigeration step. These details need clarification; no overnight schedule has been invented.

prepGroups.b: Sauce garlic, oregano, and pepper flakes

title: Tortilla Pizza Supreme
overview: Use a cast-iron skillet and a tortilla that fits inside it. Broil 6–8 inches below the element on High for 2–4 minutes, until sausage is cooked and cheese browns.

ingredients.text: 1 large flour tortilla that just fits inside your cast iron skillet
1/4 cup store-bought or homemade pizza sauce
1 1/2 ounces shredded whole milk low moisture mozzarella cheese
3 ounces raw Italian sausage, formed into 1/2-inch balls

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Set an oven rack 6–8 inches below the broiler and heat broiler to High. Heat ½ tsp olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet on high until shimmering; reduce to medium and wipe out excess oil.

Put 1 large flour tortilla rough-side down in the skillet. Spread with ¼ cup pizza sauce, 1½ oz shredded mozzarella, and ½ oz grated Parmesan. Salt lightly. Add ¼ cup diced onion, ¼ cup diced green pepper, 2 oz sliced pepperoni, 3 oz raw Italian sausage in ½-inch balls, and 2 torn basil leaves.

Broil 2–4 minutes until the sausage is cooked through and cheese is melted and browned. Sprinkle with the remaining ½ oz Parmesan. Loosen edges; if needed, crisp the bottom over medium stovetop heat, swirling and checking underneath. Slide onto a board, cut, and serve.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
overview: Slow cook on High for 3 hours, shred chicken, blend soup, then add lime juice, sour cream, and cilantro.

ingredients.text: 8 ounces chopped green chilies, canned, drained (hot or mild, depending on preference)
½ cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded (cheddar noted as an option)

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Put 1¾ lb chicken, 8 oz drained chopped green chiles, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 chopped onion (about 1 cup), two 14½ oz cans diced tomatoes with juice, 4 cups chicken broth, and 1 tbsp cumin in the slow cooker.
Cook on high for 3 hours. When chicken is tender, remove use the tines of 2 forks to shred.
blend with immersion blender

Just before serving, stir in ¼ cup lime juice, ¼ cup sour cream, and 2 tbsp chopped cilantro. Adjust salt, pepper, and Tabasco to taste. The source does not specify when to return the shredded chicken after blending; confirm this omission.
Divide the soup among bowls and top with the ½ cup shredded Monterey Jack and tortilla chips or strips. An additional lime and optional avocado are listed without a serving amount.

notes: The complete slow cooker method is used: High for 3 hours. A separate 7-minute Instant Pot note omits release instructions, so it is not used here.
Optional tortilla strips: brush corn tortillas with canola oil, cut into ¼-inch strips, salt, and bake at 375°F about 12 minutes until crisp. Quantities are unspecified.
Oil and oregano are in the file but their addition is not specified in the slow cooker directions.
The saved method removes chicken for shredding and blends the soup but does not explicitly say when to return the chicken; confirm this step.

prepGroups.a: Slow-cooker chilies, onion, garlic, cumin, broth, and tomatoes
prepGroups.b: Finishing lime juice, sour cream, and cilantro

title: Traditional Swiss Cheese Fondue
overview: Grate Gruyère and Emmental; cut bread into 1-inch pieces. Use a fondue pot and burner.

ingredients.text: 3 cups dry white wine (Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon Blanc)
1 pound French bread cut into 1" pieces

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Rub the fondue pot with 1 garlic clove. Add 3 cups dry white wine and bring almost to a boil.

Add 1 lb grated Gruyère and 1 lb grated Emmental, stirring continuously. Just before boiling, stir in 1½ tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp Kirschwasser. Continue stirring and add black pepper and optional nutmeg to taste.
Transfer pot to its burner and keep at a simmer. Serve 1 lb French bread cut into 1-inch pieces for dipping; stir the fondue with each piece.

notes: By Brad Ozerdem. The file also contains separate horseradish cream sauce and tempura batter notes, preserved in the source.

title: White Chicken Chili
overview: Use a 6-quart or larger Instant Pot and 1¾ lb raw, thawed boneless, skinless chicken breasts. High Pressure: 10 minutes; natural release: 10 minutes. Allow about 45–55 minutes total, including coming to pressure. Add beans and corn after pressure cooking; add dairy off the heat.

ingredients.text: 1¾ lb raw boneless, skinless chicken breasts, thawed; cut very large breasts in half crosswise
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
8 oz cream cheese, softened and cut into small cubes
1/4 c. chopped fresh cilantro, for serving
1/4 c. crushed tortilla chips, for serving

stages.title: Sauté the aromatics
steps: Select Sauté and heat 1 tbsp neutral oil. Add 1 chopped medium yellow onion and 1 seeded, finely chopped jalapeño. Cook 5–7 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Add 2 finely chopped garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, and 1 tsp ground cumin. Cook about 30–60 seconds, stirring, until fragrant.

stages.title: Pressure-cook the chicken
steps: Pour in 5 cups low-sodium chicken broth and add two 4½ oz cans green chiles. Scrape the bottom thoroughly until no browned bits remain. Press Cancel.

Nestle 1¾ lb raw, thawed boneless, skinless chicken breasts into the broth. Cut very large breasts in half crosswise first. Season with kosher salt and black pepper to taste. Leave the beans, corn, cream cheese, sour cream, and Monterey Jack out for now.
Seal the lid and set High Pressure for 10 minutes. When cooking ends, let pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then carefully release the remaining pressure.

Open the lid and check that the thickest part of the chicken reaches 165°F. If needed, use Sauté to simmer it in the broth until it does. Transfer the cooked chicken to a bowl and shred with two forks.

stages.title: Add the beans and finish
steps: Select Sauté on Low. Stir in two 15 oz cans drained and rinsed white beans and 1½ cups frozen corn. Simmer gently about 5 minutes, until hot. Mash roughly one-quarter of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth. For a thicker chili, simmer uncovered a few more minutes before adding dairy.
Press Cancel. Put 8 oz softened, cubed cream cheese in a bowl. Gradually whisk in about 1 cup hot broth ladled from the pot until smooth, then stir the mixture back into the chili.
Return all the shredded chicken to the pot and stir in ½ cup sour cream. Warm gently if necessary without boiling. Taste and adjust kosher salt and black pepper.
Ladle into bowls. Divide 8 oz shredded Monterey Jack, 1 thinly sliced avocado, ¼ cup chopped cilantro, and ¼ cup crushed tortilla chips among the servings, as desired.

notes: Instant Pot adaptation of your saved White Chicken Chili, using the updated 1¾ lb chicken-breast amount from your Google Doc. This version cooks raw boneless, skinless breasts directly in the pot; no separate sous-vide cooking is needed.
The original 5 cups broth and all other ingredient amounts are retained. This makes a looser chili; mash some beans and simmer uncovered before adding dairy for more body.
Cream cheese now has an explicit addition step: soften, whisk with hot broth, and stir in after pressure cooking. Add sour cream off the heat; Monterey Jack remains a serving topping.
Timing assumes thawed chicken; it is not a frozen-chicken or bone-in-chicken schedule.

Adaptation references: https://www.deliciousmeetshealthy.com/instant-pot-white-chicken-chili/ (10-minute pressure cook and cream-cheese finish); https://instantpot.com/blogs/recipes/creamy-white-chicken-chili (sauté/deglaze workflow, 10-minute natural release, and dairy after pressure cooking).

prepGroups.d: White beans and corn; add after pressure cooking

title: Chicken Mole Enchiladas
overview: Pressure cook filling on High for 5 minutes, allowing 15 minutes pressure reduction. Baked enchilada option: 350°F for 20–25 minutes.

ingredients.text: Corn tortillas for baked option (amount unspecified)
Sour cream, cotija, cilantro, and chopped avocado for topping (amounts unspecified)

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a 6-quart pressure cooker over medium heat 3–5 minutes. Cook one 8¼ oz jar DOÑA MARÍA Mole 3 minutes until softened. Add 3½ cups chicken broth, scraping the bottom and stirring about 5 minutes until smooth.
Season 2½ lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts with salt and pepper to taste. Add to the pot and stir.
Lock pressure cooker and cook on high 5 minutes. Allow additional 15 minutes for pressure to reduce.
Remove chicken and shred using forks.
Add shredded chicken back into the mixture and stir

For the flour-tortilla serving option, serve filling with the 24-count package of 8-inch flour tortillas, 1½ cubed white onions, and ½ cup chopped cilantro. Alternatively continue with the baked corn-tortilla option below.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Warm corn tortillas on a hot skillet for a few seconds in each side, or fry them lightly in oil.
Pour ¼ cup of mole sauce into the bottom of a 9×13” pan. Fill each corn tortilla with a handful of chicken and small sprinkle of cheese, then roll tightly, and place seam side down in the pan.
Pour remaining mole sauce over the top. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Remove from oven and top a drizzle of sour cream, a sprinkle of cotija cheese, cilantro and chopped avocado.

notes: The document combines a pressure-cooker mole filling with baked corn-tortilla enchiladas. It lists flour tortillas for the pressure-cooker serving option, then uses corn tortillas in the baking instructions.
Amounts for added tomatoes, enchilada cheese, sour cream, cotija, and avocado are unspecified. Added peanut butter (1 tbsp) and hot chocolate powder (1 tbsp) have no specified timing.
A separate stovetop mole-sauce variant remains in the original file.

prepGroups.a: Onion and cilantro garnish for the flour-tortilla option

title: Instant Pot Chicken Tinga
overview: Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes, then quick release. Serve with rice or tortillas and preferred toppings.

ingredients.text: 1.5 tbsp avocado oil or olive oil

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Select Sauté. Heat 1½ tbsp avocado or olive oil; add 1 yellow onion (cutting style unspecified) and 3 minced garlic cloves. Sauté 3–4 minutes. Cancel; transfer to a blender and clean the pot bottom to prevent a burn message.
Add 1 can fire-roasted diced tomatoes (size unspecified), 3 chipotle peppers, 1½ tbsp adobo sauce, 1½ tsp cumin, ¾ tsp sea salt, and 1 cup chicken broth to the blender. Blend smooth.
Pour sauce into the pot, add 3 lb chicken breasts or thighs, and seal. Cook on High Pressure 10 minutes, then quick-release.

Once steam has been completely removed, remove the lid and take out the chicken. Dice or shred using a fork and knife. Return the chicken back to the pot. At this point you can select cancel, and let the sauce cool and thicken. Or serve immediately.
Serve with rice, cauliflower rice, or tortillas. Top with ⅓ cup cilantro and optional tomatoes, avocado, or onion to taste.

notes: Tomato can size is not specified. Onion cutting style is not specified; it is sautéed then blended.

prepGroups.a: Tomatoes, chipotles, adobo sauce, cumin, salt, and broth

title: Parmesan Chicken Sheet-Pan Dinner
overview: Oven: 425°F. Potatoes bake first for 15 minutes; add chicken and beans and bake about 25 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F. Keep each component’s ingredients together.

ingredients.text: 2 lb chicken breasts, sliced and/or pounded to ½ inch thick
2 lb red potatoes, cut into bite sized pieces (if small quartered, larger potatoes will be cut into 6ths or 8ths even)
1 lb fresh green beans, ends trimmed

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Line a sheet pan with parchment for easier cleaning or spray with cooking oil.

stages.title: Potatoes first
steps: Toss 2 lb bite-size red potatoes with 1–2 minced garlic cloves, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp grated Parmesan, and salt and pepper to taste. Spread on one-third of the pan; roast 15 minutes.

stages.title: Chicken and beans
steps: Coat 2 lb chicken breasts, sliced or pounded to ½ inch, with 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, ⅓ cup grated Parmesan, ⅓ cup panko, ½ tsp pepper, and ½–¾ tsp sea salt. Add to the potato pan. Toss 1 lb trimmed green beans with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tbsp Parmesan, and salt and pepper to taste; add to the pan.
Bake for about 25 minutes or until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. For extra crispy potatoes, turn the oven to broil on high for 4-5 more minutes if desired.

prepGroups.a: Chicken coating: oil, garlic, Parmesan, panko, pepper, and salt
prepGroups.b: Potatoes with garlic, oil, Parmesan, salt, and pepper
prepGroups.c: Green beans with oil, garlic, Parmesan, salt, and pepper

title: Sheet-Pan Crispy Ramen
overview: Use the upper oven rack and broiler. Slice chicken crosswise into ½-inch pieces; finely chop garlic, grate ginger, cut scallions, and trim vegetables.

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce or 1.5 tbsp. regular sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp. sriracha, plus more for serving (optional)
2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken thin sliced breasts, sliced crosswise into 1/2"-thick pieces
2 garlic cloves, finely chopped or grated
1 bunch of scallions, cut into 1" pieces
8 oz. snow or snap peas, trimmed
4 (3-oz.) pkg. ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Arrange a rack in upper third of oven; heat broiler.
Whisk 4 tbsp reduced-sodium soy sauce (or 1½ tbsp regular), 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil, 4 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tbsp sriracha (optional), and 2 tsp chicken bouillon.
Toss 2 lb thinly sliced chicken breast with 2 finely chopped or grated garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated peeled ginger, and 3 tbsp of the prepared sauce. Reserve the rest of the sauce separately.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
On a sheet pan, toss 1 bunch scallions in 1-inch pieces, 1 lb broccoli in ½-inch florets, 8 oz trimmed snow/snap peas, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, ½ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp pepper. Arrange the chicken on top.
Broil, watching closely, until chicken is browned, 3 to 5 minutes.
Cook four 3 oz packages ramen (discard seasoning packets) in boiling water according to the package; drain and rinse cold.
Add noodles and remaining sauce to sheet pan and toss to combine. Spread in an even layer.

Continue to broil, watching closely, until noodles are crispy and broccoli is crisp-tender, 5 to 7 minutes. (For crispier noodles, toss and spread noodles again into an even layer, then broil 3 to 5 minutes more.)
Top with sesame seeds and more sriracha, if desired.

notes: Shredded carrots are listed without an amount or addition step; confirm their intended use. Soy sauce alternative is preserved as written.

prepGroups.a: Soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce, maple syrup, sriracha, and bouillon

title: Hibachi Fried Rice
overview: Prepare and cool rice ahead, overnight or with a fan as described in the source. Use a griddle; cook eggs, rice vegetables, rice, hibachi vegetables, and meat separately.

ingredients.text: Rice: source says 4 cups prepared; see note
¼ cup onion, finely chopped, for rice
Peas (optional; source has a question mark)
¼ cup matchstick carrots, cut crosswise
Broccoli, zucchini, onion, and carrots for hibachi vegetables (amounts unspecified)
Soy sauce, minced garlic, and chicken powder for griddle butter (amounts unspecified)
Soy sauce for color and salt for flavor
Sesame oil and white pepper to finish

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Prepare 4 cups rice (3 cups rice in rice cooker rinsed and fill to the 4 cup line. Add some veg oil and chicken stock). Cool over night or use a fan to dry it out
Prepare ¼ cup finely chopped onion and ¼ cup matchstick carrots, cut crosswise. Add scallions for color and optional peas; amounts are unspecified.
Prepare hibachi vegetables: broccoli, zucchini, onion, carrots,
Soften 2 sticks butter and mix with soy sauce, minced garlic, and chicken powder; seasoning amounts are unspecified.

stages.title: Cook the Fried Rice
steps: Heat Vegetable oil until smoking
Add more oil as needed
Whisk 8 eggs, cook eggs, and set aside
Cook veggies for fried rice and set aside
Fry rice with griddle butter
Combine everything
Soy sauce for color, salt for flavor
Last add some sesame oil, white pepper (but don’t cook the sesame oil because of low smoke point)
Cook Hibachi vegetables first for caramelization, then add griddle butter
Cook 3 lb chicken on the griddle, then add some of the prepared griddle butter (portion unspecified).

title: Air-Fryer Cheese Curds
overview: Use three coating bowls. Keep curds and flour together, eggs separate, and seasoned panko separate. Air fryer: 350°F.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Heat air fryer to 350°F. Coat 16 oz cheese curds in ¼ cup flour; shake off excess. Dip in 3 lightly beaten eggs, then in 2 cups panko mixed with 1 tsp garlic powder and ½ tsp cayenne.

Spritz with cooking spray. Air-fry in a single layer 5–7 minutes, flipping after 3 minutes, until crisp, lightly browned, and beginning to melt. Keep remaining curds refrigerated and repeat in batches. Serve with dipping sauce.

notes: The saved 16 oz-curd/¼ cup-flour formulation is preserved. Cooking steps were recovered from its Wisconsin Cheese source, whose current recipe uses different curd and flour quantities. The saved file also has an exactly doubled batch.

title: Asparagus with Cheese Sauce
overview: Before cooking, prepare the chopped, sliced, grated, or otherwise prepped ingredients as listed below. Keep ingredients separate unless they share a labeled prep bowl.

ingredients.text: 2 lb fresh asparagus, tough ends removed
½ cup seasoned dry bread crumbs

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Boil 2 lb trimmed asparagus in salted water or steam until tender. Drain into a greased shallow baking dish; top with 4 thinly sliced hard-cooked eggs. Heat oven to 350°F.

Melt 2 tbsp butter and blend in 2 tbsp flour. Gradually stir in 1½ cups milk and bring to a low boil. Add ½ tsp salt, ⅛ tsp cayenne, and ½ cup grated sharp cheddar; stir until melted. Pour over asparagus and eggs.
Sprinkle with ½ cup seasoned dry bread crumbs; bake about 20 minutes.

notes: Makes 6 servings. Saved from Cooks.com. The document also contains a standalone cheese sauce and two other asparagus bakes. The matching Asparagus with Cheese Sauce recipe is used here.

title: Baked Mac and Cheese (CUT Steakhouse)
overview: Serves 8–10. Prep about 20 minutes; total about 1 hour 10 minutes. Use a buttered 3–4-quart baking dish; bake at 375°F about 30 minutes and rest 10 minutes.

ingredients.text: 1 pound dried cavatappi pasta, or other bite-sized pasta tubes
6 tablespoons (3/4 stick) unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
1½ teaspoons sea salt, plus extra as needed
1¾ cups freshly shredded aged cheddar cheese

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Boil 1 lb cavatappi in salted water according to the package until al dente. Transfer immediately to ice water and stir 1–2 minutes until cool; drain well.
Preheat an oven to 375 degrees. Butter a 3- to 4-quart square baking dish. Set aside.

Melt 6 tbsp butter over medium heat. Whisk in 6 tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Add 1 bay leaf and slowly whisk in 4 cups milk. Simmer, whisking occasionally, 14–16 minutes until thick. Discard bay leaf. Whisk in 1½ cups crème fraîche and 1½ tsp sea salt; bring to a simmer.
Remove from heat and melt in 1¼ cups mozzarella and 1¼ cups cheddar. Adjust salt and white pepper to taste.
Mix the cooked pasta and sauce; stir in another 2 cups mozzarella. Spread in the greased baking dish. Top with the remaining ½ cup mozzarella and ½ cup cheddar, then ¾ cup brioche bread crumbs.

Bake in the preheated oven until the mixture is bubbly and the bread crumbs are golden brown (about 30 minutes). Remove from the oven and leave to settle at room temperature for 10 minutes before scooping and serving.

notes: From and tested by Wolfgang Puck, as credited in the saved file. Keep cheese portions separate: 1¼ cups each mozzarella and cheddar for sauce; 2 cups mozzarella mixed with pasta; remaining ½ cup each cheese for topping.

title: Smooth Hummus
overview: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Crush garlic. Cream tahini with lemon juice before adding other ingredients.

ingredients.text: 2 (15 oz) cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Drain and rinse two 15 oz cans chickpeas. Removing their skins is optional.
Blend ⅔–¾ cup tahini with ½ cup lemon juice until smooth and frothy before adding the chickpeas.
Add 4 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tsp sea salt; blend again.

Blend in the drained chickpeas about one-third of a can at a time, scraping the sides as needed, until smooth. Add ¼ cup olive oil and blend a few minutes. Add water from the listed ¼ cup gradually to reach the preferred consistency.

notes: Optional additions in the file: a large handful of parsley, 2 scallions, and ½ tsp each coriander, ginger, dry mustard, turmeric, and paprika. Their addition timing is not specified.
Cayenne and cumin amounts are unspecified. Sprinkle paprika on top. The original file also contains orange hummus and tahini sauce.
The source lists cayenne and cumin without quantities or addition timing; confirm before using them.

title: Orange Hummus
overview: Rinse and dry chickpeas. Blend all ingredients smooth and refrigerate 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

ingredients.text: Two cans garbanzo beans, rinsed and dried
1/2 teaspoon each of cumin, coriander, ginger, dry mustard, turmeric, and paprika

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Blend 2 cans rinsed and dried garbanzo beans (can sizes unspecified), ½ tsp each cumin, coriander, ginger, dry mustard, turmeric, and paprika, ¾ cup orange juice, ⅓ cup tahini, ½ tsp salt, 3 tbsp cider vinegar, 3 medium garlic cloves, 1 tsp soy sauce, and cayenne to taste until smooth.
Cover mixture and refrigerate for two hours, so flavors blend together.
Remove from refrigerator thirty minutes before serving.
Drizzle with additional olive oil, if desired.
Serve with pitas, pita chips, and multi-seed crackers or fresh-cut carrots, celery, and peppers.

notes: Garbanzo can sizes and garlic prep are unspecified in the saved source.

title: Tahini Sauce
overview: Before cooking, prepare the chopped, sliced, grated, or otherwise prepped ingredients as listed below. Keep ingredients separate unless they share a labeled prep bowl.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Blend 3 crushed garlic cloves and ½ cup tahini in a food processor or mortar and pestle. Add ½ tsp kosher salt.
Transfer to a bowl and stir in 2 tbsp olive oil and ¼ cup lemon juice. If too thick, add warm water 1 tsp at a time to the desired consistency.
Mix in the optional 1 tsp finely chopped parsley.
Serve immediately or refrigerate.

notes: “Gloves garlic” in the saved ingredient list is corrected to cloves. Serve immediately or refrigerate, as stated in the source.

title: Mojito
overview: Prepare ingredients as listed below. Keep charcoal-marked ingredients separate and follow the order in the directions.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Muddle the juice of 1 lime, 1 tbsp simple syrup, and mint leaves (amount unspecified). Add 2½ oz light rum and ice; top with soda water to taste.

notes: Source also gives a pitcher (4 servings): ¼ cup simple syrup, ½ cup lime juice, and 1 cup light rum. The single-serving note says 2½ oz rum and also “¼ cup”; these differ, so 2½ oz is retained with this clarification.

title: Orange Sesame Salad Dressing
overview: Before cooking, prepare the chopped, sliced, grated, or otherwise prepped ingredients as listed below. Keep ingredients separate unless they share a labeled prep bowl.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Combine 1 cup orange juice, ¼ cup red wine vinegar, ½ cup canola oil, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp dry mustard, 1 tsp dried dill, and 1 minced large garlic clove until evenly mixed.

title: Alice Springs Chicken
overview: Marinate refrigerated about 2 hours. Use an ovenproof frying pan; bake at 375°F for 7–10 minutes after searing.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Whip ½ cup Dijon mustard, ½ cup honey, 1½ tsp vegetable oil, and ½ tsp lemon juice about 30 seconds. Pour roughly two-thirds over 4 chicken breasts; cover and refrigerate about 2 hours. Refrigerate the other third separately for brushing and serving. Heat oven to 375°F. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Sear the chicken in the pan for 3-4 minutes per side or until golden brown. Remove pan from heat but keep chicken in the pan.
While chicken cooks, sauté 2 cups sliced mushrooms in 2 tbsp butter. Brush each seared breast with some of the clean reserved marinade; save a little for serving.

Season the chicken with salt, pepper and paprika. Stack two pieces of cooked bacon, crosswise on each chicken breast. Spoon the sauteed mushrooms onto the bacon, being sure to coat each breast evenly. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese evenly onto each breast followed by 1/4 cup of Cheddar. Bake the pan of prepared chicken breasts for 7-10 minutes or until cheese is thoroughly melted and starting to bubble. Sprinkle each breast with 1/2 teaspoon parsley before serving. Put extra honey mustard marinade into a small bowl to serve on the side.

title: Red Curry Chicken
overview: Simmer coconut milk and curry paste 5 minutes, then add the remaining ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

ingredients.text: 1.75 lb (4) chicken breasts in chunks (or shrimp)

stages.title: Simmer curry
steps: Simmer two 14 oz cans light coconut milk with 3 tbsp red curry paste for 5 minutes.
Add 1¾ lb cubed chicken (or shrimp), ¼ cup fish sauce, 1 cup frozen peas, ¼ cup brown sugar, and 1 cup chicken stock. Simmer 10 minutes; serve over rice.

notes: Optional additions in the file: fresh basil, chopped onions, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, baby corn, and red pepper. Amounts and addition times are not specified. Chicken may be replaced by shrimp.

title: Sous Vide Bacon and Gruyère Egg Bites
overview: Equipment: six 4 oz/125 ml canning jars with two-part lids and sous vide cooker. Cook at 172°F/77.8°C for 1 hour.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Set your Anova Precision Cooker for 172ºF/77.8ºC
Blend 6 eggs, ½ cup grated Gruyère, ¼ cup cream cheese, and ¼ tsp salt until smooth.
Divide 3 cooked bacon slices, halved, among 6 jars: half a slice per jar.
Divide the egg & cheese mixture evenly among the jars

Attach two-part lids and close to fingertip tightness. This means using only your fingertips to screw on the ring; if they are too tight, the air pressure within will not be able to release and the jars will shatter on the bath
Once closed, submerge the jars in the water bath and set your timer for 1 hour

stages.title: Finishing Steps
steps: Remove from the bath and enjoy straight from the jar if desired! You can also slide a butter knife around the edge, pushing gently inwards as you do so to loosen the base. Invert jar onto heat-safe surface and either sear with a torch or place under broiler for a few minutes for color.
Enjoy!

notes: Uses the complete six-jar recipe in the saved file. Several personal 12-/14-/18-egg variations at 170°F remain in the original document; their quantities are not blended into this version.

title: Sous Vide Marinated Pork Tenderloin
overview: Allow 2 hours sous vide plus searing. Optional marinade time: 4–24 hours.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Mix ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 tsp lemon pepper, and 3 minced garlic cloves. Bag with 2–3 lb pork tenderloin and remove air. Marinate 4–24 hours for best flavor.
Set water bath to 140°F/60°C and cook bagged pork for 2 hours.
Remove pork, pat dry, season lightly, and sear in a hot oiled skillet about 60 seconds per side. Rest and serve.

notes: Recovered from the Sous Vide Ways recipe linked in the saved Doc. A Serious Eats alternative remains linked in that Doc.

title: Whiskey Sour
overview: Prepare ingredients as listed below. Keep charcoal-marked ingredients separate and follow the order in the directions.

ingredients.text: 2 oz whiskey (rye in the saved recipe)

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Shake 2 oz whiskey, ¾ oz fresh lemon juice, and ¾ oz simple syrup with ice; strain into a glass.

Honey variation: 2 oz whiskey, ¾ oz lemon juice, ½ oz honey, and ½ oz hot water. Stir honey and hot water together first, then add remaining ingredients and ice, shake, and strain.
Agave variation: 2 oz whiskey, ¾ oz lemon juice, ½ oz agave nectar. Turbinado variation: 2 oz whiskey, ¾ oz lemon juice, ½ oz turbinado simple syrup.

title: Vietnamese-Style Sous Vide Pork Chops
overview: Timing depends on chop thickness. Use a sous vide cooker, food-safe bag, and hot grill.

ingredients.text: 2.7–3 lb bone-in pork chops, 1–1½ inches thick
Salt, black pepper, and garlic powder, to season

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Heat bath to the saved personal setting of 143°F. Mix 3 tbsp neutral oil, ¼ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tsp grated ginger, ½ tsp chili flakes, and 2 tbsp chopped cilantro. Season 2.7–3 lb chops with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste. Bag with half the marinade; reserve the other half separately.
Cook sealed chops 1–1½ hours for ½–1-inch cuts, or 2–2½ hours for 1¼–1½-inch cuts.
Mix 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tsp minced garlic, and ½ tsp cornstarch into the clean reserved half of the marinade. Microwave 45–60 seconds until thickened.
Dry chops, brush with glaze, and grill at 500–550°F about 40–60 seconds per side. Reserve 1 tbsp glaze for serving.

notes: Method and quantities recovered from the linked Two Kooks recipe. Its current preferred setting is 142°F; the saved personal note says 143°F and is preserved.

title: Limoncello
overview: Plan two weeks for infusion, then one day before filtering. Refrigerate or freeze.

ingredients.text: 375 ml high-proof neutral grain spirit (such as Everclear 151)

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Seal the zest of 10 pesticide-free lemons with 375 ml high-proof neutral spirit. Steep in a cool, dark place 2 weeks.
Boil 1¾ cups water with 1¼ cups sugar; cool completely. Add the syrup to the infusion; wait 24 hours. Filter twice through coffee filters, bottle, and refrigerate overnight.

notes: Complete method recovered from the Serious Eats recipe linked in the saved file. Personal cream-liqueur experiments and historical batch logs remain in the original Doc.

title: Detroit-Style Pizza
overview: Makes three 10x14-inch pizzas. Give the dough 1-2 days to cold-ferment in the pans, then finish each pizza with a five-minute par-bake and a short final bake.

ingredients.text: Butter or shortening, to grease three 10x14-inch pans
48 oz cheese total (16 oz per pizza): brick cheese preferred; white cheddar, Jack, or Havarti also work; mozzarella optional

stages.title: Mix and start the dough
steps: Combine 1050 g bread flour and 30 g kosher salt in a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook.
Stir 10½ g instant yeast into 765 g warm water (85–95°F); wait 5 minutes. Add slowly while mixing on low about 10 minutes until smooth, very wet, and sticky. Scrape the bowl as needed.
With wet hands, fold the dough into a ball. Cover and leave at room temperature 1-2 hours to begin fermentation; it should rise somewhat but does not need to double.

stages.title: Pan and cold-ferment
steps: Divide the rested dough into 3 equal balls. Grease three 10x14-inch Detroit-style pans with butter or shortening.
Place one dough ball in each pan. With wet hands, flatten and stretch it as close to the edges as possible. Cover the pans and refrigerate 1-2 days.

stages.title: Prepare for baking
steps: Bring the pans to room temperature for 3 hours. Preheat a home oven to 550F. For an outdoor pizza oven, preheat to 700-800F for about 20 minutes.
Let each dough rest in its pan 30 minutes, then stretch again so it reaches every edge. Par-bake each pizza on the bottom of a home oven for 5 minutes.

stages.title: Make Kenji's sauce
steps: Warm 2 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan. Add 3 minced medium garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, and a dash of red pepper flakes; cook just until fragrant.

Stir in one 28 oz can crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tbsp sugar, and kosher salt to taste. Simmer until slightly thickened; cool enough to spoon onto the pizzas. Sauce may be made ahead and refrigerated.

stages.title: Top, bake, and serve
steps: Top each pizza with 16 oz cheese (48 oz total across 3 pizzas): mozzarella first if using, then cubed or shredded brick cheese to the edges. Spoon the prepared sauce in wide stripes; add pepperoni or other optional toppings to taste.

For a home oven, return the pizza to the bottom rack for about 7 minutes. Broil for the last 1-2 minutes only if the cheese or pepperoni needs more browning. For an outdoor pizza oven, bake 5-6 minutes, rotate halfway through, and cover with foil if it browns too quickly.
Run a thin metal spatula around the edges, slide the pizza onto a wire rack, rest 3 minutes, finish with basil, and slice.

notes: This preserves the saved personal pan-first workflow: divide into three dough balls and spread into pans before the 1-2 day cold ferment.

The original Pala Pizza method uses the same dough formula for one 10x14-inch pizza; the saved document scales it to three pans. The par-bake-and-freeze question in the source document remains an experiment, not an adopted step.

title: New York-Style Pizza Dough
overview: Scaled dough formula with conflicting sugar and dough-ball notes; review those notes before making. Cold ferment overnight to 36 hours.

stages.title: Prepare and cook
steps: Mix 1500 g bread flour, 24–45 g sugar (unresolved source conflict; see Notes), 27 g salt, and 45 g olive oil in a stand mixer. Stir 6 g instant yeast into 975 g water at 85–95°F and wait 5 minutes. The listed optional 30 g diastatic malt has no explicit addition step; confirm sugar/malt before mixing.
Mix on medium while pouring in water; continue about 10 minutes until a smooth, slightly sticky, stretchy ball forms. Hand-knead 2 minutes, cover with the overturned bowl, and rest 20 minutes.

Personal yield note calls for 6 dough balls (450 g, or “6 415 g” in parentheses). Divide, fold, and form tight balls; cover in lightly oiled containers and refrigerate overnight or up to 36 hours. The captured original says two balls, which conflicts with the scaled formula.
Remove from refrigerator 3 hours before stretching (2 hours in a very warm house); dust lightly with flour.
